sloka: मुमोच ज्वलितम् दीप्तम् अस्त्रम् ब्रह्म विनिर्मितम् ।शरीरम् मृग रूपस्य विनिर्भिद्य शरोत्तमः ॥३-४४-१५॥
transliteration: mumoca jvalitam dīptam astram brahma vinirmitam ।śarīram mṛga rūpasya vinirbhidya śarottamaḥ ॥3-44-15॥

translations.english: The great arrow which was like a thunderbolt first pierced into the body of Maricha who had assumed the form of a deer and then tore his heart.
